image_description: A close-up portrait of a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (Blenheim variety) facing forward against a solid olive-green background. The dog has large, dark, round eyes, a short muzzle with a black nose, and long, heavily feathered ears that are chestnut/red in color. A distinct white blaze runs up the center of the forehead between the eyes. The coat appears silky with red patches on the ears and around the eyes, transitioning to white on the muzzle and chest.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The profile of the head shows a clear dome shape above the eyes and a distinct stop before the short, slightly upturned muzzle. Matches breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are prominently large, round, and very dark. They are spaced widely on the face, contributing to the characteristic gentle expression.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears hang low beside the cheeks, are covered in long wavy/feathered hair, and appear to be of appropriate length for the breed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat exhibits the classic Blenheim pattern: white base with distinct chestnut/red markings on the ears and surrounding the eyes. The white blaze is clear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible fur texture on the ears and chest appears silky and slightly wavy/straight, consistent with the breed's coat description. Feathering is evident on the ears.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a head-and-shoulders portrait; the full body, back length, and overall 'cobby' structure are not visible to verify.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Legs are mostly obscured by the framing and chest fur; hindquarters are completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this cropped portrait.
The subject is stationary/posing for a portrait; gait cannot be evaluated.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of breed-specific features (head shape, eye placement, coat pattern) against ImageNet taxonomy.
Verify anatomical correctness of visible facial features, ear attachment points, and symmetry.
Check for melting or fusion artifacts in fine hair details against the background and face.
Assess lighting consistency, shadow realism (cast shadow on left), and noise patterns.

focus_areas: Texture transition between red and white fur
Edge definition of whiskers against green background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'lozenge' marking (if present) though not strictly required for Blenheim, but ensure the red patches don't look like AI-generated smears. Verify that the whiskers emerge naturally from the muzzle and do not fade into the skin unnaturally. Check if the shadow on the left side of the dog matches the implied light source direction.
